name: demo-service
title: Demo service
description: A credential whose values are produced on this machine; no account needed.
setup:
DEMO_API_KEY is `demo_` and 32 random hex characters; DEMO_ENDPOINT is the URL in `service.url`.
Produce both and store them in one pipe: `{ printf 'DEMO_API_KEY=demo_%s\n' "$(openssl rand -hex 16)"; printf 'DEMO_ENDPOINT=%s\n' "$(cat service.url)"; } | flow credentials set demo-service --stdin`.
